out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Back door kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means. CDI: EHS instructed to keep back door completely closed to prevent pest from entering facility. CF closed back door.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Box of food stored on the floor near the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated box of food to kitchen shelf.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce (47F) stored in container at room temperature on top of 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM discarded lettuce.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed two unlabeled chemical spray bottles on shelf near 3 vat sink in kitchen and not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM labeled the chemical spray bottles.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: Observed no written vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures on site.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS GAVE MANAGEMENT A COPY FAIRFAX COUNTY’S VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP POLICY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw chicken being stored above Raw shelled eggs and Raw seafood in the walk in refrigerator. Observed a container of Raw chicken being stored on top of cooked chicken and prepared potatoes.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO MOVE ALL THE RAW CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM OF THE SHELF.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: tzatziki sauce was observed at 46f in the 2DR prep top cooler. Cooked green beans were observed at 45f-46f in the walk in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed bulk bins of sugar, flour, and other ingredients without a label.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO LABEL ALL BULK BINS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor along the cook line and in the walk in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO ELEVATE ALL FOODS OFF OF THE FLOOR. NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS CAN BE USED.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed cups and deli containers being stored in the bulk bins. Observed cooking utensils being stored in a container of lukewarm water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE CUPS AND DELI CONTAINERS. PIC TOOK THE CONTAINER OF COOKING UTENSILS TO THE DISHWASHER

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: Observed flour, sugar, dried beans and other ingredients being stored in trash bags and in plastic charcoal containers.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO REPLACE THESE CONTAINERS WITH NSF APPROVED FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC TOOK A PICTURE OF AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. PIC WILL ORDER THE PART.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook-line was being used for dumping food derbies and other materials.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. This violation has previously been cited and discussed with the certified food managers on duties during inspections. Correct this violation permanently.
